subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should the remaining WebChat active-run reconnect preservation be handled by reviving PR #41067, replacing it with a narrower current-main fix, or declaring the existing send/Stop mitigations sufficient?
rationale: Current main contains partial mitigations plus a gateway-side in-flight run signal, but the UI contract for adopting that signal is missing and the only direct recovery PR is open, conflicting, and proof-gated.

options.title: Land a narrow current-main replacement
options.body: Implement the active-run adoption contract against the refactored `ui/src/pages/chat` and `src/gateway` surfaces, preserving useful ideas from PR #41067 where applicable.

options.title: Revive PR #41067
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase it, resolve conflicts, update it to current protocol/UI surfaces, and provide live reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Explicitly narrow the expected behavior to queued sends and Stop visibility, then close only if maintainers decide active-run adoption after reconnect is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement the active-run adoption contract against the refactored `ui/src/pages/chat` and `src/gateway` surfaces, preserving useful ideas from PR #41067 where applicable.

likelyOwner.reason: Val authored the closest merged reconnect mitigations and is the strongest non-bot history signal for the remaining behavior choice.
